_comment: Realistic prospect objection utterances per archetype. Used to measure objection-detection RECALL through the live urgency gate (classifyHeuristic urgencyScore >= URGENCY_THRESHOLD). lang=fr entries deliberately probe the English-only regex weakness (F20). Add real anonymized turns over time.

items.comment: Prod 2026-07-26: qualifier between possessive and role. The old pattern required 'my' immediately before 'partner', so this scored 0.295 vs the 0.35 urgency gate and the coach stayed SILENT on a textbook authority objection.
